title: Payroll from CSV
blurb: A PPD payroll file (three credits) generated by the API from a three-line CSV. Every check passes. Names, accounts and routing numbers are made up.

title: PPD debit (Moov)
blurb: A PPD debit file written by an independent ACH library. Structure and totals pass; two lines without their trailing spaces and the old effective date are reported as warnings. Test file from the open-source Moov ACH project (Apache-2.0), unmodified.

issues.message: The line has 75 characters instead of 94; trailing spaces seem to be missing. Many banks reject such files.
The effective date 2019-06-25 is in the past; the ACH operator will settle on the next possible banking day.
The line has 55 characters instead of 94; trailing spaces seem to be missing. Many banks reject such files.

title: Wrong check digit (Moov)
blurb: The same kind of file with a wrong routing check digit in the entry: the receiving bank would return it (R28). Test file from the open-source Moov ACH project (Apache-2.0), unmodified.

issues.message: The line has 75 characters instead of 94; trailing spaces seem to be missing. Many banks reject such files.

title: Return file (Moov)
blurb: A file of returned WEB debits, as a bank sends it back. The API's returns endpoint lists each return with its code explained. Test file from the open-source Moov ACH project (Apache-2.0), unmodified.

issues.message: The effective date 2000-01-01 is in the past; the ACH operator will settle on the next possible banking day.
Since 2026-03-20 WEB debits for online purchases of goods must use the description PURCHASE. Ignore this if these debits are not purchases (e.g. subscriptions or bills).
Mixed service class 200 with debits only; some banks expect 225.
The effective date 2000-01-01 is in the past; the ACH operator will settle on the next possible banking day.
Mixed service class 200 with credits only; some banks expect 220.
